gloss: just in case; to be safe

definitions.gloss: just in case; to be safe; as a precaution
definitions.explanation: Used when doing something as a precautionary measure, even though it may not be strictly necessary. Expresses the idea of being careful or thorough.

examples.japanese: {念|ねん}のため⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おく。
examples.english: I'll check just to be safe.

examples.japanese: {念|ねん}のため⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていこう→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: Let's take an umbrella just in case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{念|ねん}のため⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: I think it's fine, but you should go to the hospital just to be safe.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common expression in everyday Japanese. Typically placed at the beginning of a clause or before the verb. ⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ means "care" or "attention," so the expression literally means "for the sake of caution."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {念|ねん}のため⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check just in case)
- {念|ねん}のため⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧… (just to be sure, may I ask…)
- {念|ねん}のため⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ (to bring along just in case)
